Want to suggest a guest?
Pavneet Singh is a renowned strategic affairs and geopolitical analyst with deep expertise in India's foreign policy, intelligence, and national security. He is a prolific author and commentator known for his sharp, unfiltered analysis of South Asian politics and global power dynamics. In this episode,
Vinamre and Pavneet discuss:
• Whether India is heading toward a civil war — and what the real tensions are
• Marco Rubio's visit to India and what it means for US-India relations
• The Middle East crisis and its implications for India
• India's foreign policy with China
